d.ko: Command the silent service. Modern Naval Warfare is the definitive tactical simulation that puts you inside the pressure hull of a Virginia-Class nuclear submarine. This uncompromising tactical simulation offers unparalleled depth in graphics, physics, and authentic combat systems.

d.zh: 指挥“无声舰队”。《Modern Naval Warfare》是一款上演于弗吉尼亚级核潜艇耐压壳内的终极战术模拟游戏。这款精益求精的战术模拟在画面、物理和真实作战系统方面拥有无与伦比的深度。
